title: Fix clean builds: test helper names collide when Unreal merges .cpp files (unity build)
acceptance: A clean build of main (no Intermediate folder) compiles with zero errors
All ETM automation tests pass after the clean build
description: Found during T-0014. The test files each define file-local helpers (Frame72, FTestWorld) in anonymous namespaces. Unreal's unity build merges committed .cpp files into Module.ETM.cpp, so CombatComponentsTest.cpp and EnemyBaseTest.cpp collide and main does not compile from a clean checkout. Earlier builds passed only because UBT compiles files with uncommitted changes separately (adaptive non-unity). Fix: bUseUnity = false for the ETM module.
